blocks.text: Machine learning jadeed zindagi ke bohat se shobon mein use hoti hai, jaise sehat, karobar, taleem aur rozmarra zindagi (Fig 6.5). Yeh idaron ko bari miqdar ka data jaldi parakhne mein madad deti hai; bohat se systems seekhe hue naqshon se khud chalte hain, jis se insani mehnat kam aur waqt bachta hai.

blocks.caption: Machine learning ke istemal
rows: Pehchan aur tashkhees ke liye tibbi data ka tajzia: tibbi tasaveer mein cancer ke khaliye dhoondna, Alzheimer ya dementia ki ibtidai alamat pehchanna, dil ki bimari ki tashkhees mein madad, taake doctor jaldi aur behtar ilaj tay karein

Gahakon ka rawaiya samajhna; farokht aur market ke rujhan ka andaza; stock ka intizam; dhoka-dahi pakarna; gahak ki khidmat ke chatbots; products tajweez karna; zyada asar-dar, data par mabni marketing
Grades behtar karne ke liye talaba ki karkardagi par nazar; har talib-e-ilm ke mutabiq parhai ka mawad; zyada zaheen hazri aur jaanch ke systems
Phones mein chehre ki pehchan; voice assistants; har shakhs ke mutabiq social media; spam filters; navigation apps mein raste; video aur music ki tajaweez; smart devices

blocks.alt: Darmiyani daira 'machine learning' chaar dabbon se jura: Sehat (tibbi tashkhees, khatre ka andaza, dawa ki daryaft), Karobar (gahakon ki baseerat, dhoka-dahi ki pakar, farokht ka andaza), Taleem (dhalti parhai, talaba ki jaanch, tutoring systems) aur Rozmarra zindagi (virtual assistants, tajaweez, smart ghar).
blocks.caption: Machine learning ke istemal (Fig 6.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Wahi chand khayalat, darja-bandi, andaza aur tajweez, har shobe mein aate hain; sirf data badalta hai.

blocks.title: Class activity
blocks.text: Talaba ke number aur grades jaise saade dataset se tay karein ke data ka kaun sa hissa training aur kaun sa testing ke liye use ho sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: Pakistan ki rozmarra zindagi mein machine learning ka aik istemal batayein aur bataein ke yeh zyada tar darja-bandi, andaza ya tajweez hai.
blocks.explanation: Maslan ride-hailing app ka kiraya aur pohanchne ka waqt batana andaza hai; phone ka spam call warning darja-bandi hai; video app ka dramay tajweez karna tajweez hai. (Doosri munasib misalein bhi durust hain.)

items: Sehat: tibbi data se pehchan aur tashkhees.
Karobar: gahak, farokht, dhoka-dahi, chatbots, tajaweez.
Taleem: karkardagi par nazar, zaati parhai; rozmarra: chehre se unlock, assistants, spam filters, navigation.
